messages:
zoe: Kickoff for OrbitGrid co-marketing. Scope: joint benchmark article, marketplace listing copy, and a 45m technical webinar. Proposed week: webinar 7/12, blog 7/14, marketplace promo 7/15-7/21.

miguel: High-level goals: attribute marketplace signups, show realistic 95th %ile latency, and demonstrate per-token cost reductions on conversational workloads.

tara: I can own the landing page and the marketplace blurb. Need a bench CSV + a short reproducibility note from eng. ETA Wed.

ash: Eng will produce `orbit_bench_2026_summary.csv` and a short `orbit_bench_readme.txt` with test harness config. I'll upload to the shared drive by Tue.

zoe: Messaging constraint: avoid absolutes. Suggested copy: "Observed up to 26% lower token cost in our workload" and add a link to methodology. Call out workload shape: chat-heavy, lots of short-turn messages.

miguel: Ops: marketplace leads -> SFDC Campaign = "OrbitGrid-Channel-2026"; add hidden field origin=orbit_marketplace and partner_tag=ORBIT-0726. Also create a webhook to #sdr-marketplace.

ash: For demo and reproducibility, I'll supply a docker snippet: `docker run -p 8080:8080 orbitgrid/demo:bench-alpha --config config/short-chat.yaml`. Include exact model (gpt-like-v1), seq_len=128, concurrency=10 in README.

tara: Landing page CTA: `Start marketplace trial` (directs to marketplace flow). I'll include two audience hooks: "Engineering" and "Product" short blocks. Need bench numbers by Thu EOD to finalize copy.

miguel: Tracking setup: utm_source=orbit_marketplace, utm_campaign=orbit-synd-0726, utm_medium=referral. Hidden form field `partner_code=ORB-0726`. Also set goal events: registration_complete and marketplace_conversion.

zoe: Webinar format: 20m joint product + partner overview, 15m benchmark deep-dive, 10m live demo, 0-20m Q&A depending on audience. Rehearsal slot week of 7/5.

ops-bot: Rehearsal reminder created -> 1810000000 (calendar invite).

ash: Legal dependency: OrbitGrid needs to approve co-marketing brief and logo use by 6/28. If missed, we can still run webinar but delay public benchmark post.

miguel: Lead routing playbook: if lead.company_size > 150 and intent=POC -> escalate to enterprise SDR within 12h; else to integrations SDR pool. Tag leads: marketplace=true, partner=orbit.

tara: A/B plan: I'll test two headlines for 72h after launch to optimize registration rate. Will prepare 4 headline variants (2 technical, 2 product).

miguel: Retention automation: if marketplace signup uses >8k tokens in first 7 days, create alert for growth@redwood to evaluate Dedicated fit.

zoe: Social plan: technical thread on X, LinkedIn post, and 2 short partner co-branded cards. Tara, can you draft 3 short posts + 1 long-form LinkedIn?
tara: Yes. Also will draft a 6-8 question FAQ for the webinar.

miguel: Measurement: we'll instrument GTM to capture utm params and partner_code; send event to analytics with `partner_attribution=orbit` on registration. Also create a conversion funnel dashboard for marketing.

zoe: Action recap: Tara (LP + social + headlines + FAQ), Nash (bench CSV + README + demo container), Miguel (tracking + SFDC routing + playbook), Zoe (partner liaison + host + GH checklist).

ops-bot: Legal approval deadline reminder -> 1717000000.

zoe: Two final notes: 1) Do not publish any external materials until legal signoff AND landing page tracking verified. 2) For transparency, include a short reproducibility appendix in the blog (config, seq_len, concurrency) but avoid raw logs.

miguel: I'll add the GTM snippet to the LP once Tara pushes the draft. Also will create an SFDC auto-assignment rule for origin=orbit_marketplace.

zoe: Thanks team. Next touchpoint Fri 6/14 10am PT to validate legal + assets. :rocket:
